verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: A.L.R.* These (letters) are proofs of this scripture; a profound Quran.
verse_text_arabic: الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīni
verse_footnote_english: *15:1 & *15:9 The divine source and the perfect preservation of the Quran are proven by the Quran's mathematical code (App. 1). God's Messenger of the Covenant was destined to unveil this great miracle. The word "Dhikr" denotes the Quran's code in several verses (15:6, 21:2, 26:5, 38:1, 38:8, 74:31). The value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230)+15+9=1254, 19x66.
verse_text_arabic_clean: الر تلك ءايت الكتب وقرءان مبين

verse_text_english: Perhaps those who disbelieved should wish to be Muslims. 3.
verse_text_arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ربما يود الذين كفروا لو كانوا مسلمين

verse_text_english: Let them eat, enjoy, and remain blinded by wishful thinking; they will find out.
verse_text_arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذرهم يأكلوا ويتمتعوا ويلههم الأمل فسوف يعلمون

verse_text_english: We never annihilated any community, except in accordance with a specific, predetermined time.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا ولها كتاب معلوم

verse_text_english: No community can hasten its end, nor can they delay it.
verse_text_arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستـٔخرون

verse_text_english: They said, “O you who received the message, you are crazy.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا يأيها الذى نزل عليه الذكر إنك لمجنون

verse_text_english: “Why do you not bring the angels, if you are truthful?”
verse_text_arabic: لَّوْمَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لوما تأتينا بالملئكة إن كنت من الصدقين

verse_text_english: We do not send down the angels, except for specific functions. Otherwise, no one will be respited.
verse_text_arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما ننزل الملئكة إلا بالحق وما كانوا إذا منظرين

verse_text_english: Absolutely, we have revealed the reminder, and, absolutely, we will preserve it.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نحن نزلنا الذكر وإنا له لحفظون

verse_text_english: We have sent (messengers) before you to the communities in the past.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أرسلنا من قبلك فى شيع الأولين

verse_text_english: Every time a messenger went to them, they ridiculed him.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يأتيهم من رسول إلا كانوا به يستهزءون

verse_text_english: We thus control the minds of the guilty.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك نسلكه فى قلوب المجرمين

verse_text_english: Consequently, they cannot believe in him. This has been the system since the past generations.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يؤمنون به وقد خلت سنة الأولين

verse_text_english: Even if we opened for them a gate into the sky, through which they climb;
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو فتحنا عليهم بابا من السماء فظلوا فيه يعرجون

verse_text_english: they will say, "Our eyes have been deceived. We have been bewitched."
verse_text_arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقالوا إنما سكرت أبصرنا بل نحن قوم مسحورون

verse_text_english: We placed galaxies in the sky, and adorned it for the beholders.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد جعلنا فى السماء بروجا وزينها للنظرين

verse_text_english: And we guarded it against every rejected devil.
verse_text_arabic: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحفظنها من كل شيطن رجيم

verse_text_english: If any of them sneaks around to listen, a mighty projectile will chase him back.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا من استرق السمع فأتبعه شهاب مبين

verse_text_english: As for the earth, we constructed it, and placed on it stabilizers (mountains), and we grew on it a perfect balance of everything.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض مددنها وألقينا فيها روسى وأنبتنا فيها من كل شىء موزون

verse_text_english: We made it habitable for you,* and for creatures you do not provide for.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīn
verse_footnote_english: *15:20 When we send astronauts into space, we provide them with precisely measured quantities of food, water, and oxygen. God created the spaceship Earth with billions of astronauts who work and reproduce; He supplied them with a self-supporting system that generates oxygen, fresh water, and a great variety of delicious foods and drinks.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا لكم فيها معيش ومن لستم له برزقين

verse_text_english: There is nothing that we do not own infinite amounts thereof. But we send it down in precise measure.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن من شىء إلا عندنا خزائنه وما ننزله إلا بقدر معلوم

verse_text_english: And we send the winds as pollinators, and cause water to come down from the sky for you to drink. Otherwise, you could not keep it palatable.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأرسلنا الريح لوقح فأنزلنا من السماء ماء فأسقينكموه وما أنتم له بخزنين

verse_text_english: And it is we who grant life and death, and we are the inheritors.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنا لنحن نحى ونميت ونحن الورثون

verse_text_english: And we already know which of you are ahead, and which are behind.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد علمنا المستقدمين منكم ولقد علمنا المستـٔخرين

verse_text_english: Your Lord will gather them all; He is wise, omniscient.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن ربك هو يحشرهم إنه حكيم عليم

verse_text_english: We created the human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد خلقنا الإنسن من صلصل من حمإ مسنون

verse_text_english: As for the jinns, we created them, before that, from blazing fire.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: والجان خلقنه من قبل من نار السموم

verse_text_english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ قال ربك للملئكة إنى خلق بشرا من صلصل من حمإ مسنون

verse_text_english: "Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحى فقعوا له سجدين

verse_text_english: The angels fell prostrate; all of them,
verse_text_arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسجد الملئكة كلهم أجمعون

verse_text_english: except Iblis (Satan). He refused to be with the prostrators.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا إبليس أبى أن يكون مع السجدين

verse_text_english: He said, "O Iblis (Satan), why are you not with the prostrators?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال يإبليس ما لك ألا تكون مع السجدين

verse_text_english: He said, "I am not to prostrate before a human being, whom You created from aged mud, like the potter's clay."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لم أكن لأسجد لبشر خلقته من صلصل من حمإ مسنون

verse_text_english: He said, "Therefore, you must get out; you are banished.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم

verse_text_english: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن عليك اللعنة إلى يوم الدين

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, respite me until the day they are resurrected."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب فأنظرنى إلى يوم يبعثون

verse_text_english: He said, "You are respited.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فإنك من المنظرين

verse_text_english: "Until the specified day and time."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, since You have willed that I go astray, I will surely entice them on earth; I will send them all astray.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب بما أغويتنى لأزينن لهم فى الأرض ولأغوينهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: "Except those among Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين

verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربك هو الخلق العليم

verse_text_english: We have given you the seven pairs, and the great Quran.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ءاتينك سبعا من المثانى والقرءان العظيم

verse_text_english: Do not be jealous of what we bestowed upon the other (messengers), and do not be saddened (by the disbelievers), and lower your wing for the believers.
verse_text_arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزوجا منهم ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمؤمنين

verse_text_english: And proclaim: "I am the manifest warner."
verse_text_arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقل إنى أنا النذير المبين

verse_text_english: We will deal with the dividers.
verse_text_arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كما أنزلنا على المقتسمين

verse_text_english: They accept the Quran only partially.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين جعلوا القرءان عضين

verse_text_english: By your Lord, we will question them all,
verse_text_arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوربك لنسـٔلنهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: about everything they have done.
verse_text_arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: amma kaanu ya'limun
verse_text_arabic_clean: عما كانوا يعملون

verse_text_english: Therefore, carry out the orders given to you, and disregard the idol worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصدع بما تؤمر وأعرض عن المشركين

verse_text_english: We will spare you the mockers,
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كفينك المستهزءين

verse_text_english: who set up another god beside GOD. They will surely find out.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يجعلون مع الله إلها ءاخر فسوف يعلمون

verse_text_english: We know full well that you may be annoyed by their utterances.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد نعلم أنك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون

verse_text_english: You shall sing the praises of your Lord, and be with the prostrators.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من السجدين

verse_text_english: And worship your Lord, in order to attain certainty.*
verse_text_arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīn
verse_footnote_english: *15:99 The practices of worship are our means of attaining certainty (Appendix 15).
verse_text_arabic_clean: واعبد ربك حتى يأتيك اليقين
